    structure ZFib.CEP.UCPMicrostate {A : Type u} [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] (τ : TracialState A) (F : Finset A) (ε : ℝ) :
    Type u

    A u.c.p. finite matrix microstate for a tracial C*-algebra.

    • n : ℕ
    • σ : TracialState (MatrixAlg self.n)
    • φ : CompletelyPositiveMap A (MatrixAlg self.n)
    • map_one : self.φ 1 = 1
    • mult_l2 (a : A) : a ∈ F → ∀ b ∈ F, L2Seminorm self.σ (self.φ (a * b) - self.φ a * self.φ b) < ε
    • trace_close (a : A) : a ∈ F → ‖τ.toPositiveLinearMap a - self.σ.toPositiveLinearMap (self.φ a)‖ < ε

            source
            def ZFib.CEP.HasStarHomApproxUCPLift (A : Type u) [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] :
            Prop

            The *-homomorphism-only weakening of HasLLP — the lifting property the extraction actually uses (the embedding emb is a *-hom, not an arbitrary u.c.p. map). u.c.p. lifting is required only for *-homs ψ : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] C, which is provable for free products of finite-dimensional algebras (Cᵐ liftability + Boca free-product CP-extension) WITHOUT general Arveson extension. Strictly weaker than HasLLP (HasStarHomApproxUCPLift.of_hasLLP), so the ¬CEP contrapositive is no weaker.

              HasStarHomApproxUCPLift A

              def ZFib.CEP.QuotientLiftCoordinateEstimates {A : Type u} [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] (τ : TracialState A) :
              Prop

              The D2 ultraproduct estimate needed after LLP lifting.

              Given a u.c.p. lift into the bounded matrix-sequence algebra whose quotient is close to the concrete ultrapower embedding on F, this hypothesis selects one coordinate where the evaluated u.c.p. map has the required L2 multiplicative and trace estimates.
